SELECT 'store' k, store_key::VARCHAR a, store_id::VARCHAR b, store_name c, city d, valid_from::VARCHAR e, valid_to::VARCHAR f, close_date::VARCHAR g FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%nokia%' OR city ILIKE '%nokia%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cal', fiscal_year, fiscal_period::VARCHAR, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date::VARCHAR, period_end_date::VARCHAR, weeks_in_period::VARCHAR, fully_loaded::VARCHAR FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=5 OR DATE '2026-10-09' BETWEEN period_start_date AND period_end_date

SELECT 'closure' k, closure_type a, closure_start_date::VARCHAR b, closure_end_date::VARCHAR c, weeks_closed::VARCHAR d FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=118
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines', count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, min(sale_date)::VARCHAR, max(sale_date)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE store_key=24 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'chan', channel_code, count(*)::VARCHAR, sum(quantity)::VARCHAR, sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity END)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key=24 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY channel_code
UNION ALL
SELECT 'load', etl_loaded_at::DATE::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR, sum(quantity)::VARCHAR, NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key=24 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'qty', CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 'nonpos' ELSE 'pos' END, count(*)::VARCHAR, sum(quantity)::VARCHAR, NULL FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key=24 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 2

SELECT p.category, p.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.quantity END) units_ex_staff, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus, count(DISTINCT p.product_key) pkeys, min(f.channel_id) cmin, max(f.channel_id) cmax
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.store_key=24 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT 'rpt' k, sum(units_sold)::VARCHAR a, sum(receipts)::VARCHAR b, sum(net_sales_before_returns)::VARCHAR c, NULL d FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=118 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

UNION ALL SELECT 'dupe_receipt_line', count(*)::VARCHAR, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no FROM f GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)

SELECT p.subcategory, p.category, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.subcategory, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
